items.source: Constructs a new RecordComponentVisitor.
items.translation: 构造一个新的RecordComponentVisitor。

items.source: The record visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls. May be null.
items.translation: 该访问者必须委托方法调用的记录访问者。可为 null。

items.source: A visitor to visit a record component. The methods of this class must be called in the following order: ( visitAnnotation | visitTypeAnnotation | visitAttribute )* visitEnd.
items.translation: 访问者用于访问记录组件。此类的这些方法必须按以下顺序调用：( visitAnnotation | visitTypeAnnotation | visitAttribute )* visitEnd。

items.source: The ASM API version implemented by this visitor. The value of this field must be one of Opcodes.ASM8 or Opcodes.ASM9.
items.translation: 此访问器实现的 ASM API 版本。该字段的值必须是 Opcodes.ASM8 或 Opcodes.ASM9 之一。

items.source: The record visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls.
items.translation: 该访问者必须委托方法调用的记录访问者。

items.source: Visits an annotation of the record component.
items.translation: 访问记录组件的注解。

items.source: Visits a non standard attribute of the record component.
items.translation: 访问记录组件的非标准属性。

items.source: Visits an annotation on a type in the record component signature.
items.translation: 访问记录组件签名中类型上的注解。

items.source:
Visits the end of the record component. This method, which is the last one to be called, is
used to inform the visitor that everything have been visited.
items.translation: 访问记录组件的末尾。此方法是最后被调用的方法，用于通知访问者所有元素都已被访问。

items.source: api - the ASM API version implemented by this visitor. Must be one of Opcodes.ASM8 or Opcodes.ASM9.
items.translation: api - 此访问者实现的 ASM API 版本。必须是 Opcodes.ASM8 或 Opcodes.ASM9 之一。

items.source: api - the ASM API version implemented by this visitor. Must be Opcodes.ASM8.
items.translation: api - 此访问者实现的 ASM API 版本。必须是Opcodes.ASM8。

items.source: recordComponentVisitor - the record component visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls. May be null.
items.translation: recordComponentVisitor - 此访问者必须委托方法调用的记录组件访问者。可为 null。

items.source: descriptor - the class descriptor of the annotation class.
items.translation: descriptor - 注解类的类描述符。

items.source: visible - true if the annotation is visible at runtime.
items.translation: visible - 如果注解在运行时可见，则为 true。

items.source:
the record visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls, or 
    null.
items.translation: 该访问者必须委托方法调用的记录访问者，或为 null。

items.source:
a visitor to visit the annotation values, or null if this visitor is not
    interested in visiting this annotation.
items.translation: 访问该注解值的访客，或者如果此访客对该注解不感兴趣则为 null。

items.source: The ASM API version implemented by this visitor.
items.translation: 此访问者实现的 ASM API 版本。

items.source: Visits the end of the record component.
items.translation: 访问记录组件的末尾。

items.source: typeRef - a reference to the annotated type. The sort of this type reference must be TypeReference.CLASS_TYPE_PARAMETER, TypeReference.CLASS_TYPE_PARAMETER_BOUND or TypeReference.CLASS_EXTENDS. See TypeReference.
items.translation: typeRef - 对已注解类型的引用。此类型引用的类型必须为TypeReference.CLASS_TYPE_PARAMETER、TypeReference.CLASS_TYPE_PARAMETER_BOUND或TypeReference.CLASS_EXTENDS。请参阅TypeReference。

items.source: typePath - the path to the annotated type argument, wildcard bound, array element type, or static inner type within 'typeRef'. May be null if the annotation targets 'typeRef' as a whole.
items.translation: `typePath` - 在 `typeRef` 内到注解类型参数、通配符边界、数组元素类型或静态内部类型的路径。如果注解针对整个 `typeRef`，则可能为 null。

items.source: attribute - an attribute.
items.translation: attribute - 一个属性。

items.source: Remi Forax, Eric Bruneton
items.translation: Remi Forax, Eric Bruneton

items.source: Field Details
items.translation: 字段详情
